axes.name: layout-skeleton
axes.description: The SET of domPath values present in a composition (order-independent). Distance: Jaccard dissimilarity of the two variants' domPath sets.

axes.name: section-order
axes.description: The SEQUENCE of domPath values, position-aligned (order-dependent). Distance: fraction of positions where the two variants' element-at-position differ.

axes.name: motion-timeline
axes.description: The motionSignature assigned per element, position-aligned. Distance: fraction of positions with a differing motion signature.

axes.name: breakpoint-behavior
axes.description: The breakpoint assigned per element, position-aligned. Distance: fraction of positions with a differing breakpoint assignment.

combination: score = max(min-pairwise-distance over each axis) -- any ONE axis showing genuine, uniform variation across every pair in the trio is sufficient; the four axes are not required to move in lockstep.
note: Frozen before any W8 work per PRD S7-3/S7-4. Color, background, font, and CSS class names are deliberately absent from this axis set and from the composition schema itself (see evals/selector/scorer/diversity.ts) -- a recolor-only or class-name-only trio has no field to move any of these four axes, so it scores 0 by construction, not by a special case.
